text:
mia: Ok team — launching paid push Wed AM. Need search + retarget pacing plan, creative refresh, and webinar inbound routing. High-level: 3 search ad groups, retarget creative rotate, budget ramp 20% -> 50% over first 48h. Thoughts?
tyler: Love it. What's geo + CPA targets? Can we do dayparting for the webinar times? :calendar:
mia: Geo = US + CA. Target CPA = $45 per sign-up. Webinar times 11am PT and 5pm CET — dayparting window 8a-8p local.
sam: For search: separate brand / non-brand / competitors ad groups. Add RLSA for returning visitors. Recommend max CPC auto-bid with tCPA $40 brand, $50 non-brand.
nana: Retarget creative refresh plan: rotate 3 creatives, 14-day lookback, exclude converters. Assets uploaded: https://docs.google.com/xyz (folder: MarLaunch/Retarget)
priya: Landing has two CTAs (Register + Demo). Webinar registrants should route to HubSpot campaign = 'MarLaunch-Webinar'. Important: add utm_campaign=marlaunch_webinar and hidden field source_paid=search_retarg_mar
campaign-bot: Reminder: Suggested scaling rule -> scale_budget("search-main", "+20%", "0-24h"), then "+30%" (24-48h) IF CTR > 1.5% AND CVR > 3%. Also auto-fallback to lower-capacity model if CPA > 150% target.
tyler: Need stop-loss too — set override: pause campaign if CPA > 150% of target for 2 consecutive hours.
sam: Ad plan: responsive search ads, headline A/B test, pin sitelink to webinar page. Example copy: "Ship LLM features with predictable inference — Register Mar 25 webinar."
mia: Retarget specs: image sizes 1200x628, 1:1, 9:16; CTAs: 'Register' vs 'See Demo'. Keep copy <90 chars for mobile.
nana: I'll push campaigns to ad platform and set frequency cap = 3/day for retargeting. Will exclude converters via list.
priya: For routing: HubSpot form hidden field 'source_paid'='search_retarg_mar' + webhook to SDR queue 'webinar_inbound'. Also tag contacts with 'paid_webinar_mar'.
tyler: Also set GA4 campaign params and ensure landing load <2s — I saw a script causing a 800ms delay on mobile.
mia: Ops — can we get a quick page perf sweep? cc @ana
ana: Did the quick fix (removed legacy tracking snippet). Page now ~1.6s on mobile Lighthouse.
sam: I'll run monitoring in first 6h and post snapshot in #marketing. If CTR/CVR look good, follow campaign-bot scaling rules.
mia: Action items: Tyler -> bids + stop-loss; Sam -> upload creatives + enable dashboard; Ana -> push campaigns + page perf; Priya -> HubSpot routing + UTMs. I'll consolidate in the launch doc later. Thanks all :rocket:
